note: Bavli: [Avodah Zarah 11a:12](sefaria:Avodah_Zarah.11a.12) (13 segments). Gazetteer: “Rabban Gamliel the Elder”. Footnote 515 has his son רבן שמעון בן גמליאל הזקן, not him.

item: רבי אלעא הזקן / רבי אלעאי הזקן
note: Bavli: [Kiddushin 40a:17](sefaria:Kiddushin.40a.17) (2 segments). Gazetteer: “Rabbi Ela the Elder / Rabbi Ilai the Elder”. Same saying, two spellings: also Chagigah 16a:13.
Bavli: [Chullin 29b:3](sefaria:Chullin.29b.3) (3 segments). Gazetteer: “Levi the Elder / Rabbi Levi the Elder”. Also 'רבי לוי סבא' Bava Kamma 72a:8 and Eruvin 97b:8.
Bavli: [Kiddushin 65b:9](sefaria:Kiddushin.65b.9) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Rav Adda the Elder”. Brother of Mar Zutra, sons of Rav Mari bar Issur.
Bavli: [Pesachim 51a:9](sefaria:Pesachim.51a.9) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Rav Avira the Elder”.
Bavli: [Arakhin 17a:2](sefaria:Arakhin.17a.2) (18 segments). Gazetteer: “Rabbi Eliezer the Great”. 18 segments.
Bavli: [Megillah 28a:10](sefaria:Megillah.28a.10) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Rabbi Neḥunya the Great”.

Bavli: [Moed Katan 5a:16](sefaria:Moed_Katan.5a.16) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Rabbi Uzziel, grandson of Rabbi Uzziel the Great”. 'רבי עוזיאל בר בריה דרבי עוזיאל רבה': רבה separates grandfather from grandson.
Bavli: [Sanhedrin 19a:13](sefaria:Sanhedrin.19a.13) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Rabbi Yoshiya the Great”.
Bavli: [Bekhorot 36a:11](sefaria:Bekhorot.36a.11) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Rava Zuti”. Paper has רבה זוטי and רבינא זוטי, not Rava.
Bavli: [Arakhin 16b:21](sefaria:Arakhin.16b.21) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Rava the Younger”. Steinsaltz: 'Rava the Younger'. זעירא as suffix on an amora.
Bavli: [Menachot 15b:9](sefaria:Menachot.15b.9) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Rabbi Abba the small”.
Bavli: [Bava Kamma 59a:20](sefaria:Bava_Kamma.59a.20) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “Eliezer Ze’eira”. Suffix זעירא and no honorific, like the paper's אושעיא זעירא. Fits 'No honorific' too.
